notes: Demo videos used to exercise the detection pipelines in CI (scripts/fetch_demo_videos.py).
Videos are NOT stored in the repo: they are downloaded at CI time from Wikimedia Commons, and only
files whose license allows redistribution and derivatives (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA) are used.
Each run records title, author, license and source page in sources.json next to the downloaded files.
'commons_file' pins an exact file (picked from earlier CI candidate lists); 'commons_search' takes the best licensed matches of a search.
'exercise_id' is the app tracker the clip is replayed against and 'relevance' says why it is a spine-care clip; the mapping is ours, not a clinical label.

Only spine-care material is used: neck (cervical) mobility, shoulder-blade and upper-back posture work, and back-extensor / thoracic work. Openly licensed lumbar clips (cat-cow, McKenzie, bridges) were searched for and not found on Commons.
